summary: Candidate is a distinct session-level workflow for Spring Boot 3.0 data access layer migration (Hibernate, R2DBC, database drivers, migration tools). It addresses a specific migration domain (data access technologies) that is semantically separate from the peer candidates (configuration/core framework, web/actuator, build tools). No existing skill in the registry covers data access layer migration. The existing skills in the registry (Flink DataStream, StreamExecutionEnvironment) are from a completely different domain (stream processing) and asset_type/task_family, so no merge or relationship applies.
